text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Prime Minister Antonio Guterres to attend meeting of Socialist deputies on Thursday after party's top policy-making body votes to back controversial deal with main opposition party on constitutional reform.
- Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said taxes and government expendiutre to fall in 1999. Government sets budget deficit target for 1999 of two percent of gross domestic product.
- Prime Minister Antonio Guterres inaugurates the natural gas network in Coimbra.
- Proposals for use of EU funds for training amount to 40 billion escudos, twice the 20 billion escudos available.
- Banco Portugues de Investimento and Banco de Fomento & Exterior to be integrated in 1998.
- Insurance Company Tranquilidade registered 2.5 billion escudo consolidated net profit in 1996, 24.4 per cent more than in 1995.
- Portugal's postal service CTT will have to cut prices to prepare for liberalisation.
- Banco Portugues de Investimento Group posted 15.1 billion escudo profit in 1996, 56 per cent up on 1995.
